command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell monkey -p moe.shizuku.privileged.api -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; sleep 2; echo '=== process after manager launch ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell ps -A | grep -i shizuku || true; echo '=== top activity ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -E 'mResumedActivity|topResumedActivity' | head -n 5 || true; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/shizuku-window.xml >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '=== visible UI text ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /sdcard/shizuku-window.xml 2>/dev/null | sed 's/></>\n</g' | grep -o 'text="[^"]*"' | head -n 120 || true; echo '=== Shizuku logs ==='; adb -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d -v brief | grep -iE 'shizuku|wireless debugging|adb pair|start.sh' | tail -n 200 || true; echo phase2d_shizuku_start_diagnostic_complete=true
